verdict.rationale: The mem0 CLI is documented to delete memories from the terminal, and webhooks fire on memory deletion events, so on-demand deletion of individual memories is evidenced. However, nothing shows per-entity bulk deletion or full erasure. The expiration feature explicitly states 'Nothing is deleted,' so it does not satisfy erasure requirements. Missing for 10: documented per-entity (user/agent/app) bulk delete, full account/project erasure, privacy/GDPR-oriented deletion guarantees, and independent corroboration.
